notices.title: Lehi City Planning Commission Meeting Agenda
notices.agenda_text:
LEHI CITY PLANNING COMMISSION NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING


On August 13, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. in the Lehi Civic Center Council Chambers located at 131 North 100 East, the Lehi City Planning Commission will hold a public hearing to receive public comment on the following items:

Public hearing and consideration of JDH Development's request for approval of the Vivian Estates 5B preliminary subdivision including 10 single family lots located at approximately 600 East and 300 East.  (Tabled at the July 9, 2026 meeting) 

Public hearing and consideration of Bryan & Adrianne Summers' request for approval of an exception for the Shuman Homes' 8-foot fence located on the western property line at 1749 W 525 S. 

Public hearing and consideration of Mike Greene's request for approval of a conditional use permit for the Greene Flag Lot located at 2001 W 1500 N. 

Public hearing and consideration of Nathan McBride's request for conditional use approval of a flag lot located at 1175 East 900 North in the RA-1 and R-1-8 zones.   

Public hearing and recommendation of the Estate of Nancy Walker's request for review of the Nancy Walker Development Agreement on 2.581 acres of property located at 915 W State Street, allowing certain restricted Heavy Commercial uses on the property and other site restrictions for commercial development. 

Public hearing and recommendation of Perry Commercial's request for review of an amendment to the Traverse Mountain Area Plan changing approximately 5 acres located at Timpanogos Highway and Mountain View Road from High Density Residential to Highway Commercial.  

Public hearing and consideration of Brent Ventura's request for approval The Temple View Villas Plat B flag lot conditional use and preliminary subdivision for 2 single family lots located at 337 East Ohana Way in the RA-1 zone. 

Public hearing and consideration of Brent Ventura's request for approval The Temple View Villas Plat C flag lot conditional use and preliminary subdivision for 2 single family lots located at 326 East Ohana Way in the RA-1 zone. 

Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi City's request for the Jay Peterson Zone Change changing 0.406 acres located at 3455 N Center Pointe Drive from Public Facility (PF) to Transitional Holding (TH-5)  

Public hearing and consideration of Lehi City's request for approval of an exception to the Water Department Storage Building located at 2548 North 300 West requesting an exception to the glass requirement. 

Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi City's request for review of a Development Code Amendment to Chapter 19, Renewable Energy Systems, updating the maximum allowed kW for residential systems. 

Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi City's request for review of a Development Code Amendment to Table 37.080, Table of Off-Street Parking Requirements, adding new parking requirements for preschools and daycares offering specialized therapy with higher student/teacher ratios. 

Public hearing and consideration of Kairos Land Development's request for review of the Belmont Flex Suites Condo Plat, condominimizing a building into 10 individual units located at 1552 North Boston Street.

Lehi Planning Commission Meeting

Agenda

July 9, 2026

7:00 PM - Lehi City Council Chambers, (131 N. 100 E., Lehi, UT 84043)

1.	Call to Order

2.	Consent Agenda

2.1. Approval of the minutes from the June 4, 2026 meeting

2.2. Approval of the minutes from the June 11, 2026 meeting

3.	Regular Agenda

3.1. Consideration of Trademark Visual's request for conditional use approval of two pylon signs for The Collective commercial development located at 3700 North Morning Vista Road and requesting an exception for greater height and sign area. (Tabled from 6/11/26 meeting)


3.2. Public hearing and consideration of Andrew Ward's request for approval of an exception for an 8-foot fence located at 1337 S 1880 W.


3.3. Public hearing and consideration of JDH Development's request for approval of Vivian Estates Phase 5A preliminary subdivision including 2 single family lots located at 2070 North 600 East in the RA-1 Zone.


3.4. Public hearing and consideration of JDH Development's request for approval of the Vivian Estates 5B preliminary subdivision including 10 single family lots located at approximately 600 East and 300 East.


3.5. Public hearing and consideration of Kevin and Sarah Gordon's request for approval of the Lehi Childcare Facility Site Plan located at 808 North 2300 W and requesting exceptions for buffering standards and building footprint size.


3.6. Public hearing and recommendation of Symphony Home's request for review of the Fox Trail Subdivision Concept Plan, now requesting nine lots and a development agreement, located at 2850 West 1500 North.


3.7. Public hearing and recommendation of Gardner-Plumb Group's request for review of an amendment to the Gardner Plumb Development Agreement, requesting to transfer 124 equivalent residential units from the northern portion of the development agreement to the southern.


3.8. Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi City's request for review of a comprehensive Development Code Amendment to Chapter 23, Signs updating requirements and simplifying the text.


3.9. Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi City's request for review of an amendment to the Lehi City Design Standards and Public Improvement Specifications Manual adding Section 3.08- Temporary Construction Site Safety Measures for commercial and residential construction projects.


3.10.Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi City's request for review of a Development Code Amendment to Chapter 11 Development Application requirements, updating requirements for site plans, infrastructure site plans, preliminary and final subdivisions. 

3.11.Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi City's request for review of updates to the Lehi Storm Water Management Plan 2026.



3.12.Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi City's request for review of an amendment to Chapter 38 updating requirements for the Mixed-Use Zone.


4.	City Business

5.	Adjournment



Public is invited to attend all open meetings


In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Lehi will make reasonable accommodations to participate in the meeting. Requests for assistance can be made by contacting the City Recorder at 385-201-2269 This Agenda has been posted in accordance with Utah Code §§ 63G-30-102 Agendas may be amended up to 24 hours prior to a meeting

A Closed Meeting may be called to order pursuant to Utah Code §§ 52-4-204 & 52-4-205


The order of agenda items may change to accommodate the needs of the legislative body, staff, or the public Electronic participation may be permitted for one or more members of the legislative body and staff
